title: canary-rollout-personal-notes-owen-bryant
content:
Personal scratchpad for canary rollout v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 (latency improvements + kernel swap)

Context:
- Target: roll v3.3.0 (includes reduced attention kernel, nv-fused matmul) to 10% traffic canary on dedicated and hosted API for 48h.
- Goal: validate p95 latency improvement, no quality regressions, no elevated error rate.
- Owner: Owen B. (eng-release).
- Notes: still waiting on final quant config from infra (PR 1885) — if not merged by Friday, hold pinning to canary.

Quick checklist (first pass):
- [ ] Confirm model artifact tags: redwood/model-x:3.3.0, fallback redwood/model-x:3.2.1
- [ ] Add version pin for canary route in routing policy (route-id: embed-prod-canary)
- [ ] Update canary config: 10% traffic, route duration 48h, rollback auto at 12% error delta or p95 regression > 20ms
- [ ] Smoke test (local + staging): run prompt set A/B (see below) — baseline + canary responses must be within quality threshold
- [ ] Add canary cohort to tracing: sample 100% of canary requests for 12h
- [ ] Ensure metric alerts in Datadog: error-rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, token generation stalls, OOM events
- [ ] Notify CS + SRE + oncall before starting (Slack #releases, DM SRE lead)
- [ ] Create ephemeral dashboard (canary-3.3.0-owen) and share link

Rollout steps (operational):
1) Preflight (T-48h): confirm artifacts, merge infra PR for quant config, confirm infra nodes have kernel hotfix
2) Preflight (T-2h): create dashboard, update routing policy, add canary tag to model registry, open rollout window in calendar
3) Start canary (T0): flip routing policy to 10% -> 90% baseline, kick off smoke tests (20 synthetic requests across seq len distribution), verify trace sampling
4) Monitor (T0 -> T+4h intensive): watch p50/p95, error-rate, token-latencies, and quality diffs on eval set. Post hourly notes in thread.
5) Expand / hold: if stable at 48h and no regressions, prepare staged ramp; otherwise rollback immediately.

Rollback criteria (strict):
- error-rate increase > 12% absolute relative to baseline over 10m window
- p95 latency regression > 20ms sustained for 10m (or > 30ms for 3 consecutive 5m buckets)
- increase in 5xx or token-stall events (>= 3 events within 5m)
- qualitative regression: >1% degradation on evaluation prompts (see prompts below)

Post-mortem triggers:
- Any rollback or manual stop -> auto-create postmortem doc and assign to release owner
- Otherwise, owner to write short incident summary and signal to PMs

Version pinning notes:
- For dedicated, pin worker-side model to redwood/model-x:3.3.0 and leave control-plane fallback to 3.2.1 (so quick rollbacks via routing policy possible)
- For hosted, use routing policy to direct 10% to model-x:3.3.0 instance group; ensure canary instances are labeled for billing and tracing
- Keep KV cache compatibility in mind: 3.3.0 changes key schema slightly — need to invalidate shared prefix cache for canary clients only. Add header X-Canary-Model:3.3.0 in requests to isolate cache entries.

Smoke/eval prompt sets (quick):
- A: short-chat (5 tokens response), medium context (512 tokens) to test KV cache warmup impact
- B: long-document summarization (6k token input) to exercise attention kernel swap (use sample docs in /datasets/release-eval/longs)
- C: safety prompts from safety-regression-list (10 noisy variants)

Observability & dashboards:
- Metric groups: tokens/sec, tokens/second/server, request_ms_{p50,p95,p99}, generation_stall_count, gpu_memory_free, total_errors, 5xx_count
- Traces: ensure spans include kernel name, quant_mode, seq_len, model_tag
- Logs: capture model startup/worker OOM traces, kernel fallback events, quant errors

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- What is expected cache invalidation window if we isolate via header? (ask infra)
- If PR 1885 doesn't land, can we apply kernel swap as hotpatch? (riskier)
- Confirm cost impact for 10% traffic: estimated +3% GPU hours, check billing with finance for spikes
- Need a short blurb for PM about user-visible risk to include in customer comms (if canary sees issues)

Slack message template (prep):
"Starting canary for model-x:3.3.0 -> 10% traffic for 48h. Owner: Owen Bryant. Watch p95 and errors. Rollback criteria: p95 > +20ms or error-rate +12%. Dashboard: <link>. Notifying CS/SRE. DM me for immediate rollback."

Notes to self (rough):
- Keep this doc as working scratchpad; transfer to canary-runbook template when finalizing.
- Add short list of sample requests used in smoke tests to Confluence page.
- Remind Maya to run eval scripts with new kv-cache header flag.

End of scratchpad.
